message: CDS view sets @AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED — confirm no sensitive data is exposed without a DCL
CDS view entity has no @AccessControl.authorizationCheck annotation — rows may be exposed without a DCL access control (TALOS RAP-SEC-002)
@AbapCatalog.sqlViewName is legacy DEFINE VIEW syntax; migrate to define view entity (no SQL view)
Draft-enabled entity without an optimistic-concurrency guard — set @ObjectModel.draftEnabled.lockingMode: #OPTIMISTIC and expose an ETag via @Semantics.systemDate.lastChangedAt (ABAP-PERF-23)
Analytical Fiori consumer without @Analytics.dataCategory — annotate #FACT/#DIMENSION so aggregation pushes to the analytical engine (ABAP-PERF-24)
Virtual element runs per-row at fetch time and breaks server-side filtering — compute via association or a view function if filterability matters (ABAP-PERF-25)
$expand-able composition [0..*] without a cardinality cap — restrict via @ObjectModel.expand.maxItems or split into a paged sub-resource (ABAP-PERF-22)
RAP behavior declares early numbering — switch to late numbering for create-heavy entities (ABAP-PERF-40)
Deep create enabled via association — BDEF grammar has no payload cap, so bound the child collection size in the consumer/action (ABAP-PERF-41)
RAP behavior mixes managed and unmanaged implementation in one BO — inverts the savepoint contract; pick one mode per BO (ABAP-PERF-42)
Missing @ObjectModel.usageType.serviceQuality — declare the view's plan-stability class (#A..#D) as part of its runtime contract (ABAP-PERF-84)
Missing @ObjectModel.usageType.sizeCategory — declare the expected result-set size as part of the view's runtime contract (ABAP-PERF-84)
Missing @ObjectModel.usageType.dataClass — declare the data class (#TRANSACTIONAL/#MASTER/...) as part of the view's runtime contract (ABAP-PERF-84)
CDS view has no @AbapCatalog.viewEnhancementCategory — declare it (e.g. [#NONE]) so enhancement behavior is an explicit contract (ABAP-PERF-26)
